[[Unbound]] is an [[ascended back item]] earned through the [[Fractals of the Mists]]. It is the [[precursor]] to the [[legendary back item]], [[Ad Infinitum]].

* {{salvages into|1 Agony Infusion}} (5)

== Notes ==
* This item can be crafted multiple times.
** When crafted the first time you need 2 initial [[Ball of Dark Energy|Balls of Dark Energy]], but will end up with 2 left over, because [[Finite Result]] and [[Upper Bound]] salvage into so many of them.
*** You will however need the 2 leftover ones as well as a 3rd additional [[Ball of Dark Energy|Ball of Dark Energy]] for [[Ad Infinitum|Ad Infinitum]].
** For every copy beyond the first you will need a total of 35 [[Ball of Dark Energy|Balls of Dark Energy]].

== Notes ==
* Salvage rate research can be found [[Ball of Dark Energy/Salvage Rate|here]].
* A cheap and straightforward way to get Balls of Dark Energy is to buy an ascended armor piece from [[Raid encounter]]s vendor [[Smoxxi]] and then salvage it with an [[Ascended Salvage Tool]]. e.g. The [[Defender's Chest of Boots]] will cost 150 [[Magnetite Shards]] and 5 gold. [[Crafting]] an ascended armor piece for salvaging is another option, but it's several times more expensive, requires [[Account Bound|account bound]] materials and a respective [[Crafting#Crafting_disciplines|crafting profession]] leveled to 500.
** Another caveat to crafting is that some of the more recently added ascended items ''do not'' appear to have their salvage tables set up correctly, and do not salvage into Balls of Dark Energy. An example of this would be the [[Empowered Boneskinner's Totem]].
* While some [[precursor weapon]]s are of {{rarity|Ascended}} rarity, salvaging them '''does not''' guarantee a Ball of Dark Energy.

[[Reclaimed Metal Plate]]s are [[token]]s that can be salvaged from [[Reclaimed weapon]]s. They can be exchanged for [[Plated weapon]]s with the [[Whispers Keeper (Dragon's Stand)|Whispers Keeper]] in [[Dragon's Stand]].

== Acquisition ==
=== Sold by ===
{{Sold by}}

=== Salvaging ===
* Salvaged from [[Reclaimed weapons]].
** Rare salvage from {{rarity|Fine}} (1%) and {{rarity|Masterwork}} (3%) variants.
** 100% salvage from {{rarity|Rare}} variant.

=== Contained in ===
{{contained in}}

== Used in ==
{{recipe list by discipline}}

== Currency for ==
{{Vendor query table|currency=Reclaimed Metal Plate}}

== Notes ==
* It takes 38 {{item icon|Reclaimed Metal Plate}} (in addition to the map currencies) to complete the [[Plated weapon]] Collection, 2 for each one-handed weapon, and 3 for each of the two-handed weapons.
* 30 {{item icon|Reclaimed Metal Plate}}s are required for the {{item icon|Gift of Dedication|Gifts of Dedication}} for each set of [[Perfected Envoy armor]]; a total of 90 for all three sets.
* Assuming you buy the {{item icon|Provisioner Token}}s solely with {{item icon|Reclaimed Metal Plate}}s, an additional 50 are needed per piece of [[Perfected Envoy armor]]; 300 per weight class, or 900 for all three sets.
